sources.purpose: Tick sync starts from requested timestamp; a timeout or pending request is not proof of absence.
Bounded native broker tick retrieval; inspect count and error together.
Historical economic-calendar values; timestamps use trading-server time and do not prove prior schedule availability.
Trading server GMT+3 in European summer, GMT+2 otherwise; the frozen parameter is currently10800.
Historical CPI/NFP schedule revisions exist; guessing first-Friday or fixed-month news is invalid.
Official FOMC meeting/statement/minute dates; not a complete imported year calendar.
Broker description of real-tick mode; no symbol-specific first tick or retention guarantee was established.
